verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־ אַהֲרֹ֑ן בְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לֹֽא־ יִטַּמָּ֖א לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ בְּעַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn bə·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem lō- yiṭ·ṭam·mā lə·ne·p̄eš bə·‘am·māw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Speak to Aaron’s sons the priests and tell them [that] [a priest] is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם־ הַקָּרֹ֖ב אֵלָ֑יו לִשְׁאֵר֔וֹ לְאִמּ֣וֹ וּלְאָבִ֔יו וְלִבְנ֥וֹ וּלְבִתּ֖וֹ וּלְאָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- haq·qā·rōḇ ’ê·lāw liš·’ê·rōw lə·’im·mōw ū·lə·’ā·ḇîw wə·liḇ·nōw ū·lə·ḇit·tōw ū·lə·’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: except . . . for his immediate . . . family his mother father son daughter or brother

verses.original: הַבְּתוּלָה֙ וְלַאֲחֹת֤וֹ הַקְּרוֹבָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיְתָ֖ה לֹֽא־ לְאִ֑ישׁ לָ֖הּ יִטַּמָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bə·ṯū·lāh wə·la·’ă·ḥō·ṯōw haq·qə·rō·w·ḇāh ’ê·lāw ’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh lō- lə·’îš lāh yiṭ·ṭam·mā
verses.literal: or his unmarried sister who is near to him since she has no husband - -

verses.original: לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּ֖א בַּ֣עַל בְּעַמָּ֑יו לְהֵ֖חַלּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yiṭ·ṭam·mā ba·‘al bə·‘am·māw lə·hê·ḥal·lōw
verses.literal: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage . . . and so profane himself

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִקְרְחָה קָרְחָה֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם וּפְאַ֥ת זְקָנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ יִשְׂרְט֖וּ שָׂרָֽטֶת׃ וּבִ֨בְשָׂרָ֔ם לֹ֥א
verses.transliteration: lō- yiq·rə·ḥå̄h qā·rə·ḥāh bə·rō·šām ū·p̄ə·’aṯ zə·qā·nām lō yə·ḡal·lê·ḥū yiś·rə·ṭū śā·rā·ṭeṯ ū·ḇiḇ·śā·rām lō
verses.literal: Priests must not make bald . . . spots on their heads shave off the edges of their beards . . . . . . or make cuts in their bodies . . .

verses.original: יִהְיוּ֙ קְדֹשִׁ֤ים לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי֩ אֶת־ הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם יְהוָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨י לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם וְהָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yih·yū qə·ḏō·šîm lê·lō·hê·hem wə·lō yə·ḥal·lə·lū šêm ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem kî ’eṯ- hêm maq·rî·ḇim Yah·weh ’iš·šê le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·hā·yū qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God Because - they present to the LORD the food offerings the food of their God they must be holy

verses.original: לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאִשָּׁ֛ה אִשָּׁ֨ה וַחֲלָלָה֙ זֹנָ֤ה לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑חוּ גְּרוּשָׁ֥ה מֵאִישָׁ֖הּ כִּֽי־ ה֖וּא קָדֹ֥שׁ לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lō yiq·qā·ḥū wə·’iš·šāh ’iš·šāh wa·ḥă·lā·lāh zō·nāh lō yiq·qā·ḥū gə·rū·šāh mê·’î·šāh kî- hū qā·ḏōš lê·lō·hāw
verses.literal: [A priest] must not marry . . . a woman defiled by prostitution or - divorced by her husband for [the priest] is holy to his God

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־ אֶת־ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֑יב לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יִֽהְיֶה־ קָדֹשׁ֙ לָּ֔ךְ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קָד֔וֹשׁ מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qid·daš·tōw kî- ’eṯ- hū maq·rîḇ le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yih·yeh- qā·ḏōš lāḵ kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh qā·ḏō·wōš mə·qad·diš·ḵem
verses.literal: You are to regard him as holy since - he presents the food of your God He shall be holy to you because I the LORD am holy I who set you apart

verses.original: כִּ֥י כֹּהֵ֔ן וּבַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ תֵחֵ֖ל לִזְנ֑וֹת אֶת־ הִ֣יא מְחַלֶּ֔לֶת אָבִ֙יהָ֙ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃ס בָּאֵ֖שׁ
verses.transliteration: kî kō·hên ū·ḇaṯ ’îš ṯê·ḥêl liz·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- hî mə·ḥal·le·leṯ ’ā·ḇî·hā tiś·śā·rêp̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: If a priest’s daughter . . . defiles herself by prostituting herself - she profanes her father she must be burned in the fire

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֵן֩ הַגָּד֨וֹל מֵאֶחָ֜יו אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ שֶׁ֤מֶן יוּצַ֥ק עַל־ רֹאשׁ֣וֹ׀ וּמִלֵּ֣א אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ לִלְבֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־ הַבְּגָדִ֑ים אֶת־ לֹ֣א רֹאשׁוֹ֙ יִפְרָ֔ע יִפְרֹֽם׃ וּבְגָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl mê·’e·ḥāw ’ăšer- ham·miš·ḥāh še·men yū·ṣaq ‘al- rō·šōw ū·mil·lê ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw lil·bōš ’eṯ- hab·bə·ḡā·ḏîm ’eṯ- lō rō·šōw yip̄·rā‘ yip̄·rōm ū·ḇə·ḡā·ḏāw lō
verses.literal: The priest who is highest among his brothers who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been ordained - - to wear - the priestly garments - must not {let} his hair hang loose or tear his garments . . .

verses.original: וְעַ֛ל לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑א כָּל־ מֵ֖ת נַפְשֹׁ֥ת לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּֽא׃ לְאָבִ֥יו וּלְאִמּ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al lō yā·ḇō kāl- mêṯ nap̄·šōṯ lō yiṭ·ṭam·mā lə·’ā·ḇîw ū·lə·’im·mōw
verses.literal: - He must not go near any dead body he must not defile himself even for his father or mother

verses.original: וּמִן־ לֹ֣א יֵצֵ֔א וְלֹ֣א הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ יְחַלֵּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ אֱלֹהָ֑יו כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר מִשְׁחַ֧ת שֶׁ֣מֶן אֱלֹהָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- lō yê·ṣê wə·lō ham·miq·dāš yə·ḥal·lêl ’êṯ miq·daš ’ĕ·lō·hāw kî nê·zer miš·ḥaṯ še·men ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘ā·lāw ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: - He must not leave . . . - or desecrate - the sanctuary of his God for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him I am the LORD

verses.original: אִשָּׁ֥ה וְה֕וּא יִקָּֽח׃ בִבְתוּלֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: ’iš·šāh wə·hū yiq·qāḥ ḇiḇ·ṯū·le·hā
verses.literal: The woman he marries must be a virgin

verses.original: לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑ח כִּ֛י אִם־ אַלְמָנָ֤ה וּגְרוּשָׁה֙ וַחֲלָלָ֣ה זֹנָ֔ה אֶת־ אֵ֖לֶּה יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּֽׁה׃ בְּתוּלָ֥ה מֵעַמָּ֖יו
verses.transliteration: lō yiq·qāḥ kî ’im- ’al·mā·nāh ū·ḡə·rū·šāh wa·ḥă·lā·lāh zō·nāh ’eṯ- ’êl·leh yiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh bə·ṯū·lāh mê·‘am·māw
verses.literal: He is not to marry . . . . . . a widow a divorced woman or one defiled by prostitution - - He is to marry . . . a virgin from his own people

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יְחַלֵּ֥ל זַרְע֖וֹ בְּעַמָּ֑יו כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yə·ḥal·lêl zar·‘ōw bə·‘am·māw kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šōw
verses.literal: so that he does not defile his offspring among his people for I am the LORD who sanctifies him

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר לְדֹרֹתָ֗ם אִ֣ישׁ לֹ֣א מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֞ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם יִקְרַ֔ב לְהַקְרִ֖יב לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām ’îš lō miz·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’ă·šer yih·yeh ḇōw mūm yiq·raḇ lə·haq·rîḇ le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: Say to Aaron - For the generations to come - none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God

verses.original: כִּ֥י כָל־ לֹ֣א אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם יִקְרָ֑ב אִ֤ישׁ עִוֵּר֙ פִסֵּ֔חַ א֥וֹ חָרֻ֖ם א֥וֹ א֣וֹ שָׂרֽוּעַ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl lō ’îš ’ă·šer- bōw mūm yiq·rāḇ ’îš ‘iw·wêr p̄is·sê·aḥ ’ōw ḥā·rum ’ōw ’ōw śā·rū·a‘
verses.literal: - No . . . man who has any defect may approach no man who is blind lame . . . disfigured . . . or deformed

verses.original: א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בֶר רָ֑גֶל א֖וֹ שֶׁ֥בֶר יָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ’îš ’ă·šer- yih·yeh ḇōw še·ḇer rā·ḡel ’ōw še·ḇer yāḏ
verses.literal: no man who has a broken foot or . . . hand

verses.original: אֽוֹ־ גִבֵּ֣ן אוֹ־ דַ֔ק א֖וֹ בְּעֵינ֑וֹ תְּבַלֻּ֣ל גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת א֖וֹ א֤וֹ מְר֥וֹחַ אָֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- ḡib·bên ’ōw- ḏaq ’ōw bə·‘ê·nōw tə·ḇal·lul ḡā·rāḇ ’ōw yal·le·p̄eṯ ’ōw ’ōw mə·rō·w·aḥ ’ā·šeḵ
verses.literal: or who is a hunchback or dwarf or who has an eye defect a festering rash . . . scabs . . . or a crushed testicle

verses.original: כָּל־ אִ֞ישׁ מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֣א אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֣וֹ מ֗וּם יִגַּ֔שׁ לְהַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־ אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מ֣וּם בּ֔וֹ אֵ֚ת לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ לְהַקְרִֽיב׃ לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’îš miz·ze·ra‘ ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên lō ’ă·šer- bōw mūm yig·gaš lə·haq·rîḇ ’eṯ- ’iš·šê Yah·weh mūm bōw ’êṯ lō yig·gaš lə·haq·rîḇ le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: No . . . descendant of Aaron the priest . . . who has a defect shall approach to present - the food offerings to the LORD [Since] he has a defect - he is not to come near to offer the food of his God

verses.original: יֹאכֵֽל׃ מִקָּדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו וּמִן־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים
verses.transliteration: yō·ḵêl miq·qā·ḏə·šê haq·qo·ḏā·šîm le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hāw ū·min- haq·qo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy [food]

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ כִּֽי־ מ֣וּם בּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א לֹ֣א יָבֹ֗א וְאֶל־ אֶל־ הַפָּרֹ֜כֶת יִגַּ֖שׁ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לֹ֥א יְחַלֵּל֙ אֶת־ מִקְדָּשַׁ֔י כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ kî- mūm bōw wə·lō lō yā·ḇō wə·’el- ’el- hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ yig·gaš ham·miz·bê·aḥ lō yə·ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- miq·dā·šay kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šām
verses.literal: but because he has a defect - he must not go . . . near the veil or approach the altar vvv so as not to desecrate - My sanctuaries For I am the LORD who sanctifies them

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶֽל־ וְאֶל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn bā·nāw wə·’el- wə·’el- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Moses told this to Aaron and his sons . . . and to all the Israelites . . .
